Reporting To	Executive Director

About the Role
 Strategic Planning & Insights at Delmo Chicken & Agro (Pvt) Ltd will support the Group’s strategic growth agenda by researching new business and investment opportunities, evaluating market potential and internal capabilities, and preparing feasibility studies and business cases. The role will also support decision-making for senior management and monitor approved projects against investment assumptions, milestones and expected returns, highlighting risks and recommending corrective actions when required.
Key Responsibilities
•	Identify and screen potential business, market-entry and investment opportunities by monitoring industries, technologies and adjacent markets.
•	Conduct market and competitor research, including market sizing, growth trends, customer needs, regulations and industry value chains.
•	Assess opportunities against Delmo’s strategy, existing capabilities, operational readiness, potential synergies and capability gaps.
•	Prepare feasibility studies and investment business cases with Finance and business teams, covering commercial and operational viability.
•	Develop financial models and evaluate CAPEX, OPEX, revenue, margins, cash flows and investment returns using NPV, IRR, payback and relevant measures.
•	Conduct risk, sensitivity and scenario analyses; recommend practical alternatives such as phasing, partnerships or changes to project scope.
•	Prepare clear presentations and evidence-based recommendations for senior management on whether to proceed, modify, partner, defer or stop opportunities.
•	Track approved strategic projects against business cases, stage-gate milestones, risks, assumptions and key dependencies; raise deviations promptly.
•	Monitor post-investment results, expected benefits, financial returns and agreed KPIs; support project reviews and corrective-action recommendations.
•	Support Group strategic planning, maintain project and investment dashboards, and capture lessons learned to strengthen future decisions.
Candidate Profile
•	Degree or recognized professional qualification in Business Management, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Analytics or a related field.
•	Approximately 4–6 years of relevant experience in strategic planning, corporate strategy, business development, investment analysis, consulting or financial analysis.
•	Hands-on experience in market research, feasibility studies, business-case preparation and financial modelling.
•	Ability to evaluate investment opportunities, assess risks and commercial viability, and apply NPV, IRR, payback and scenario analysis.
•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and research skills, with the ability to convert complex data into actionable business insights.
•	Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills; ability to prepare dashboards, management reports and executive presentations.
•	Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills, with experience working with Finance, business teams and project stakeholders.
•	Excellent written and verbal English communication, attention to detail, commercial judgement and a proactive, results-oriented approach.
Preferred / Added Advantages
•	Postgraduate qualification in Strategy, Finance, Economics or Business Analytics; CFA or relevant investment/project qualifications.
•	Experience with new business evaluation, market entry, expansion projects or diversified-group investment studies.
•	Exposure to food, agriculture, manufacturing, retail, FMCG or related industries.
•	Working knowledge of BI / dashboard tools, research databases and validated AI-enabled analytical tools; Sinhala and/or Tamil proficiency.
